<html lang="en" style="--gp: 0.0000;"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<style>
/* Moonlit Nikah: a crescent night, hanging fanoos, a skyline you fly into, jaali doors that open onto a lantern-lit courtyard,
   then emerald velvet, a star pattern route, and a dua that rises as a star beside the moon. */
:root{
  --night:#0A1230; --night-2:#131D48; --emerald:#0B5D4B; --emerald-d:#053A2F; --velvet:#04261E;
  --gold:#E8C66F; --gold-2:#C99A3E; --gold-d:#8C6420; --ivory:#FBF6EA; --ivory-2:#F3EBD8;
  --ruby:#9E1B32; --ink:#1B2238; --ink-2:#5B6378; --wa:#25D366; --on-wa:#10231A;
  --f-display:"Cormorant Garamond","Cormorant",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --f-ui:"Figtree",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
  --f-ar:"Amiri","Noto Naskh Arabic","Geeza Pro","Traditional Arabic",serif;
  --W:min(100vw,1040px,max(78vh,360px));
  --gl:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)); --gr:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));
  color-scheme:dark;
}
@supports (height:1svh){:root{--W:min(100vw,1040px,max(78svh,360px))}}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:#070C22 url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='56' height='56'><path d='M28 18l3 7 7 3-7 3-3 7-3-7-7-3 7-3z' fill='none' stroke='%23E8C66F' stroke-opacity='.16'/></svg>");color:var(--ivory);font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.5;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-x:clip}
body.locked{overflow:hidden}
img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
button{font:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:6px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.inv{position:relative;width:min(100%,var(--W));margin-inline:auto;background:var(--night);box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5);overflow-x:clip}
.lbl{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-size:.7rem;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.amp{font-style:italic;font-weight:400}
.ar{font-family:var(--f-ar);direction:rtl;line-height:1.6}
.sec{position:relative;padding:64px var(--gr) 64px var(--gl);display:grid;gap:14px;justify-items:center;text-align:center}
.sec h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,calc(var(--W) * .1),3.2rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05}
.lede{max-width:30ch;font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.4}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.gold-t{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFF3C8 0%,#E8C66F 45%,#B98632 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
.orn{width:150px;height:22px;color:var(--gold)}
.band{height:16px;width:100%;position:relative;z-index:3;background:
  linear-gradient(#8C6420,#8C6420) top/100% 2px no-repeat,
  linear-gradient(#8C6420,#8C6420) bottom/100% 2px no-repeat,
  url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='24' height='16'><rect width='24' height='16' fill='%23053A2F'/><path d='M12 2l2.4 3.6L18 8l-3.6 2.4L12 14l-2.4-3.6L6 8l3.6-2.4z' fill='%23E8C66F'/></svg>") center/24px 16px repeat-x}

/* progress thread and music */
.thread{position:fixed;top:0;left:50%;width:var(--W);height:3px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:60;pointer-events:none}
.thread i{display:block;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--emerald),var(--gold),var(--ruby));transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--gp,0))}
.music{position:fixed;z-index:55;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 12px);right:max(12px,calc((100vw - var(--W)) / 2 + 12px));width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(232,198,111,.6);background:rgba(10,18,48,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);color:var(--gold);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.music[hidden]{display:none}
.music .eq{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:16px}
.music .eq i{width:3px;height:30%;background:currentColor;border-radius:2px}
.music.on .eq i{animation:eq .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.music.on .eq i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:-.3s}.music.on .eq i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:-.6s}.music.on .eq i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:-.15s}
@keyframes eq{from{height:20%}to{height:100%}}

/* hanging fanoos */
.hang{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;pointer-events:none}
.fz{position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:0;width:calc(var(--W) * var(--s));margin-left:calc(var(--W) * var(--s) / -2);transform-origin:50% 0;animation:swing var(--sd,4.5s) ease-in-out var(--sdl,0s) infinite alternate}
.fz::before{content:"";display:block;margin:0 auto;width:2px;height:var(--ch);background:linear-gradient(#3B2A0E,#B8892F)}
.fz img{width:100%;margin-top:-2px}
.fz i{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:24%;width:230%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,190,90,.42),rgba(255,150,50,0) 62%);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes swing{from{transform:rotate(-3.5deg)}to{transform:rotate(3.5deg)}}

/* gate: light the lantern */
.gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:70;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;background:#0A1230;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .9s ease 1.1s,visibility 0s linear 2s}
.gate[hidden]{display:none}
.gate::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20px;background:url("/assets/flagship/muslim/sky.webp") center 20%/cover;filter:blur(8px) brightness(.5) saturate(1.1)}
.gate > *{position:relative}
.g-lamp{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:min(30vw,130px);margin-left:max(-15vw,-65px);transform-origin:50% 0}
.g-lamp::before{content:"";display:block;margin:0 auto;width:2px;height:16svh;background:linear-gradient(#3B2A0E,#B8892F)}
.g-lamp img{width:100%;margin-top:-2px;filter:brightness(.38) saturate(.5);transition:filter .8s ease}
.g-lamp i{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:22%;width:320%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,50%) scale(.4);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,196,96,.6),rgba(255,150,50,0) 60%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .8s ease,transform 1.2s ease}
.g-in{display:grid;gap:10px;justify-items:center;max-width:340px;margin-top:22svh}
.g-in .ar{font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--gold)}
.gate .lbl{color:#F3E2B6}
.gate h1{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,13vw,3.8rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1;color:#FFF6E2}
.gate h1 .amp{color:var(--gold)}
.open{margin-top:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;border:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFE7A6,#E2B04E);color:#2B1A05;font:700 1rem var(--f-ui);cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(232,170,60,.4);animation:pulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.open svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.gate small{font:500 .8rem var(--f-ui);color:#C9CDE2}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(232,170,60,.3)}50%{box-shadow:0 10px 44px rgba(232,170,60,.7)}}
.gate.lit .g-lamp{animation:swing 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.gate.lit .g-lamp img{filter:brightness(1.12) saturate(1.1)}
.gate.lit .g-lamp i{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,50%) scale(1)}
.gate.lit .open{animation:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}
.gate.lit{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}

/* pinned scenes */
.scene{position:relative;height:calc(var(--h) * 1vh);height:calc(var(--h) * 1svh)}
.stage{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden}
@supports (height:1dvh){.stage{height:100dvh}}
.layer{position:absolute;pointer-events:none}

/* 1 · crescent night, lanterns, the skyline rises and we fly in */
#s-sky{--h:360;
  --rise:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .04) / .38),1);
  --z:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .48) / .4),1);
  --fl:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .8) / .14),1);
  --tt:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .06) / .2),1);
  --sw:calc(var(--W) * 1.5)}
#s-sky .stage{background:#0B1638}
.sky{inset:-4% -2% 0;background:url("/assets/flagship/muslim/sky.webp") center top/cover;transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * 4%)) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * .25));will-change:transform}
.hang.top{z-index:3;transform:translateY(calc(var(--p,0) * -60svh));opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--z) * 2),1)}
.title{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 33svh);display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:center;text-align:center;opacity:calc(1 - var(--tt));transform:translateY(calc(var(--tt) * -50px));z-index:4}
.dear{font-style:italic;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,calc(var(--W) * .062),2rem);color:#F6DC9A;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(5,10,30,.8);padding-inline:.4em;max-width:100%}
.title .lbl{color:#F3E6C8;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(5,10,30,.9)}
.names{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(3.4rem,calc(var(--W) * .18),6.4rem);line-height:.9;color:#FFF6E2;text-shadow:0 3px 26px rgba(5,10,30,.85)}
.names .amp{display:block;font-size:.5em;line-height:1.15;color:var(--gold)}
.when{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;letter-spacing:.42em;color:#F3E6C8;padding-left:.42em;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(5,10,30,.9)}
.skyline{left:50%;bottom:0;width:var(--sw);z-index:2;transform-origin:50% 88%;
  transform:translate(-50%,calc((1 - var(--rise)) * 100%)) translateY(calc(var(--z) * (var(--sw) * .0627 - 50svh))) scale(calc(1 + var(--z) * var(--z) * 7));will-change:transform}
.skyline img{width:100%}
.skyline .glow{position:absolute;left:50%;top:88%;width:30%;aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,244,210,.95),rgba(255,200,110,.5) 34%,rgba(255,170,60,0) 68%);opacity:calc(.2 + var(--z));mix-blend-mode:screen}
.flash{inset:0;z-index:8;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#FFFBEF,#FFEFC8 55%,#F7DC9C);opacity:var(--fl)}
.hint{left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 18px);z-index:6;text-align:center;font:600 .68rem var(--f-ui);letter-spacing:.3em;color:#F3E6C8;opacity:calc(1 - var(--p,0) * 14)}
.hint i{display:block;margin:8px auto 0;width:12px;height:12px;border-right:2px solid currentColor;border-bottom:2px solid currentColor;transform:rotate(45deg);animation:nudge 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nudge{50%{transform:translateY(6px) rotate(45deg)}}

/* 2 · jaali doors open onto the courtyard */
#s-jaali{--h:320;--f:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--p,0) / .08),1);--b:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .12) / .45),1);--c:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .56) / .4),1)}
#s-jaali .stage{background:#0B1638}
.court{inset:0;transform-origin:50% 62%;transform:scale(calc(1.22 - .22 * var(--b)));will-change:transform}
.court img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 100%}
.doors{left:50%;top:50%;width:max(100%,calc(100svh * .6276));aspect-ratio:900/1434;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(calc(1 + .05 * var(--b)));perspective:1200px;opacity:clamp(0,calc((1 - var(--b)) * 3),1)}
.half{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:50%;overflow:hidden;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;will-change:transform}
.half img{position:absolute;top:0;height:100%;width:200%;max-width:none}
.half.l{left:0;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:rotateY(calc(var(--b) * -100deg))}
.half.r{right:0;transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:rotateY(calc(var(--b) * 100deg))}
.half.l img{left:0}.half.r img{right:0}
.half::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(10,16,40,calc(var(--b) * .5))}
.doors .shine{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:70%;height:80%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:radial-gradient(ellipse,rgba(255,226,150,.5),rgba(255,200,100,0) 65%);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:breathe 3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes breathe{from{opacity:.55}to{opacity:1}}
.flash2{inset:0;z-index:8;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#FFFBEF,#FFEFC8 55%,#F7DC9C);opacity:var(--f)}
.door-card{left:50%;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8svh);width:min(calc(var(--W) - 56px),340px);transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;padding:14px 18px 12px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(8,14,40,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid rgba(232,198,111,.55);opacity:clamp(0,calc(1 - var(--b) * 3),1);display:grid;gap:2px;z-index:5}
.door-card .ar{font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.4}
.door-card p:last-child{font-size:1.1rem;color:#F3E6C8;font-style:italic}
.welcome{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 6svh);text-align:center;display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:center;opacity:var(--c);transform:translateY(calc((1 - var(--c)) * 20px));z-index:5}
.welcome .lbl{color:#F3E6C8;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.welcome p:last-child{font-size:clamp(2rem,calc(var(--W) * .09),3rem);font-weight:600;color:#FFF6E2;text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.8);line-height:1.05}

/* 3 · emerald velvet: bismillah, ayah, families, events */
.velvet{position:relative;padding:40px var(--gr) 72px var(--gl);display:grid;gap:14px;justify-items:center;text-align:center;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(2,30,24,.45),rgba(2,30,24,.6)),url("/assets/flagship/muslim/velvet.webp") center top/340px repeat,var(--velvet);color:#FFF4DE}
.velvet::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-70px;height:200px;background:linear-gradient(rgba(6,40,31,0),#06281F 35%,rgba(6,40,31,.75) 60%,rgba(6,40,31,0));pointer-events:none}
.velvet > *{position:relative}
.velvet .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.bism{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,calc(var(--W) * .09),2.8rem);color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.ayah{width:100%;max-width:440px;margin:10px 0 6px;padding:22px 20px 18px;border-radius:20px;background:rgba(3,22,18,.5);border:1px solid rgba(232,198,111,.5);display:grid;gap:10px;justify-items:center}
.ayah blockquote{margin:0;font-size:1.3rem;font-style:italic;line-height:1.45;color:#FFF0D2}
.ayah cite{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-style:normal;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold)}
.cn{display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:center;margin:6px 0 4px}
.cn .par{font-weight:600;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.3;color:#FFF6E6}
.cn .req{font-style:italic;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.35;color:#F3DDB2;max-width:30ch;margin:4px 0 6px}
.cn .nm{font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(3rem,calc(var(--W) * .15),5rem);line-height:1;padding:2px .15em 4px;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.cn .with{font-style:italic;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.2}
.cn .of{font-style:italic;font-size:1.12rem;line-height:1.35;color:#F3DDB2;max-width:30ch;text-wrap:balance}
.nw{white-space:nowrap}
.on-day{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-weight:600;font-size:.82rem;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#F3DDB2}
.ev-head{margin-top:34px;display:grid;gap:8px;justify-items:center}
.ev-head h2{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,calc(var(--W) * .1),3.2rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#FFF6E6}
.evs{display:grid;gap:46px;width:100%;margin-top:18px;justify-items:center}
@media (min-width:700px) and (min-height:720px){.evs{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:start}}
.ev{display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:center;max-width:360px}
.archf{position:relative;width:min(78%,290px);aspect-ratio:640/976;margin-bottom:12px;filter:drop-shadow(0 18px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.archf .pic{position:absolute;inset:0;-webkit-mask:url("/assets/flagship/muslim/arch-mask.png") center/100% 100% no-repeat;mask:url("/assets/flagship/muslim/arch-mask.png") center/100% 100% no-repeat;background:#06231C}
.archf .pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.archf .fr{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.ev .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.ev h3{font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#FFF6E6}
.ev .day{font-weight:600;font-size:1.3rem}
.ev .where{font-style:italic;color:#F3DDB2;line-height:1.35;margin-top:4px}
.ev .ev-note{font-family:var(--f-ui);font-size:.82rem;color:#D8E6DF;margin-top:6px}
.acts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:14px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:46px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--gold);font:600 .92rem var(--f-ui);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
.pill.solid{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFE7A6,#E2B04E);border-color:#E2B04E;color:#2B1A05}
.pill svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none}

/* 4 · an eight-point star pattern draws itself and leads to the venues */
#s-route{--h:230}
#s-route .stage{background:radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 45%,#1A2A66 0%,#111C4A 55%,#0A1230 100%)}
#s-route .stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.2;background:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='80' height='80'><g fill='none' stroke='%23E8C66F' stroke-width='.8'><path d='M40 22l5 13 13 5-13 5-5 13-5-13-13-5 13-5z'/><path d='M0 0l10 10M80 0l-10 10M0 80l10-10M80 80l-10-10'/></g></svg>")}
.r-top{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 7svh);display:grid;gap:6px;justify-items:center;text-align:center}
.r-top .lbl{color:var(--gold)}
.r-top h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,calc(var(--W) * .09),3rem);font-weight:600;line-height:1.05;color:#FFF6E2}
#star{left:50%;top:52%;width:min(calc(var(--W) * .86),58svh);aspect-ratio:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
#star svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(255,214,120,.45))}
#star path{fill:none;stroke:#F3D58A;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
#star circle{fill:#F3D58A;opacity:clamp(0,calc(var(--p,0) * 9),1)}
.routes{left:var(--gl);right:var(--gr);bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 5svh);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;pointer-events:auto;opacity:clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .82) * 9),1);transform:translateY(calc((1 - clamp(0,calc((var(--p,0) - .82) * 9),1)) * 16px))}
.routes .pill{background:rgba(10,18,48,.6)}
